scripts.lint: uv run --project apps/story-engine --extra dev ruff check apps/story-engine/src apps/story-engine/tests && pnpm --filter @story-engine/desktop lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run --project apps/story-engine --extra dev mypy --config-file apps/story-engine/pyproject.toml apps/story-engine/src/story_engine && pnpm --filter @story-engine/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @story-engine/desktop typecheck
scripts.test: uv run --project apps/story-engine --extra dev pytest -c apps/story-engine/pyproject.toml apps/story-engine/tests && pnpm --filter @story-engine/desktop test
scripts.build: uv run --project apps/story-engine --extra dev python -m build apps/story-engine && pnpm --filter @story-engine/desktop build
